name: Ink Well
author: Trance
description: Everything drains into the middle. A frame around the edge of the screen sings the waveform and is drawn inward in a slow spiral, its brightness colored in ink-and-paper bands, so the screen is always full and always sinking. The low mids turn the spiral, beats thicken the frame and shed sparks off it.

layers.point:
w = t*tau
k = 0.97 + 0.05*v*(0.6 + 0.6*mid_att)
c = cos(w)
s = sin(w)
x = sign(c)*pow(abs(c), 0.35)*aspect*k
y = sign(s)*pow(abs(s), 0.35)*k
